monsters.name: Cinder Stalker
monsters.actionsMarkdown:
### Traits

**Shadow Stealth.** While in dim light or darkness, the stalker can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

**Pack Tactics.** The stalker has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet.

### Actions

**Multiattack.** The stalker makes two claw attacks.

**Claw.** Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Shifting Enigma
monsters.actionsMarkdown:
Flicker: The enigma blinks 10 feet when hit.

**Bite**: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) psychic damage.
